ColonyCouncil.DilemmaDef.label: a match the colonist is against

texts.li: {FACTION} have agreed to a match between {A_nameDef} and {X_nameDef}: {LIVES}. {A_nameDef} doesn't want it, and has asked the council to hear {A_objective} out before anything is settled.
[another] {FACTION} said yes to a match between {A_nameDef} and {X_nameDef}. {A_nameDef} loves {B_nameDef}, and has asked the council not to give {A_objective} to someone else for the colony's sake.
[another,away] {FACTION} want {A_nameDef} to marry {X_nameDef} and go to live at {TOWN}. {A_nameDef} would be leaving {B_nameDef} behind, and has told the council so in plain words.

[children] {A_nameDef} would go to live at {TOWN} if the match with {X_nameDef} goes ahead, and {A_possessive} children would stay here. {A_nameDef} has asked the council not to send {A_objective} away from them.
[dislike] {A_nameDef} can't stand {X_nameDef}, and {FACTION} have just agreed to marry the two of them. {A_nameDef} has come before the council to say so before it is too late.

[dislike,empire] {X_nameDef} of {FACTION} holds a title and expects a match to match it. {A_nameDef} has met {X_objective}, didn't like {X_objective}, and wants the council to know before it says yes.

li.label: Press the match all the same
li.outcome: The council heard {A_nameDef} out and kept its word to {FACTION}: {LIVES}. {A_nameDef} said nothing more about it.

li.label: Withdraw the match
li.outcome: The council sided with {A_nameDef} and sent word to {FACTION} that the match is off. They took it with a little less warmth than before.
